**Finding: COMPLIANT (no redline proposed).**

- **Responsive location:** Section 14.1 (p0746) — the sole term provision. The Term runs from the Effective Date to the earlier of termination under Section 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment.
- **Searches run:** "renew" (only IP/lien/insurance uses), "automatically renew", "extension of the Term", "then-current term / successive terms / expiration notice prior", "price increase / CPI", and a full read of the Term and Termination section opening. No auto-renewal, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-escalation language exists anywhere.
- **Why compliant:** This is a milestone-driven development funding structure with a finite, event-based term. The fallback and preferred conditional elements ("if renewal is automatic…", "if renewal permits price increases…") are not engaged, and any extension would require a mutually signed amendment — effectively the preferred "mutual written agreement" outcome.
- **Deliberately not done:** No auto-renewal clause was inserted. Drafting one would manufacture exit friction and a notice window against PB where none currently exists, which would weaken our position rather than cure a gap.
